reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code make this feel less like a random TikTok supplement, and the pre-counted sachet means I can't forget half my doses. $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee is low enough to try once.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium might do nothing for me, and I only get my money back if I finish all 30 sachets.
